useful_delta: R05 now has a durable authority matrix separating canonical shared input law, candidate shared visual/material owners, reconstructed V9 evidence and V45 lab-only ideas.

The V9-versus-bicolor contradiction is resolved for future integration: preserve corroborated physical affordance observations, but do not transplant V9's free-accent/multi-role palette into strict material.bicolor.
touch-first authority is explicit: SPEC is canonical, v1 is Current by owner spec, v2 remains CANDIDATE_NOT_HUMAN_ACCEPTED behind browser + Human acceptance gates.
Selector V45 sound profiles Oiled/Machine/Snap/Brown/Relay/Soft are durable evidence only; no R05 source promotes them to canonical shared sound ownership.

Twelve negative-knowledge rules now guard against authority inflation, global raised surfaces, decorative third colors, hover/precision dependencies, duplicated gesture stacks and drag-triggered activation.
decisions: No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or Lineage pointer changes are justified by R05 recovery.
controls-v9 remains RECONSTRUCTED; authentic original V9 bytes remain unknown/unrecovered.
controls.physical_material has no registered Human Accepted exact artifact.
interaction.touch-first owns reusable pointer/gesture mechanics; product pages must not create competing generic adapters where that owner applies.
Strict two-color physical material routes to material.bicolor candidate ownership; Design Kernel v2 and Material v2 remain candidates rather than global skins.
Sound-profile experimentation remains candidate/local until an authoritative shared sound owner or explicit acceptance evidence is recovered.
shared_discoveries: Calendar, Capture, Navigator and future page workers should treat interaction.touch-first as the canonical interaction law while preserving each product's own skin/ownership.

The bicolor shared extraction is candidate-integrated even though its README says it derives from accepted Calendar language; shared extraction acceptance must not be inferred from source-language acceptance.
A reconstructed visual specimen can donate corroborated mechanism evidence without donating literal palette implementation or authority status.

global_delta_candidates.summary: R05 tactile boundary: interaction.touch-first SPEC is canonical with v1 Current; touch v2, Design Kernel v2, Material v2 and material.bicolor v1 remain candidates; controls V9 is reconstructed only; selector V45 sounds/themes are lab evidence. Reuse existing owners but do not promote or transplant V9 free-accent/multi-tone details into strict bicolor material.

negative_knowledge: Do not use a higher version number as authority.
Do not call reconstructed V9 authentic or Human Accepted.
Do not promote touch-first v2 over v1 without its declared representative browser + Human acceptance gate.
Do not raise page/content/shell surfaces by default; depth communicates manipulability.
Do not synthesize decorative third colors/helper tones inside strict bicolor material.
Do not transplant V9's free accent wheel into material.bicolor.
Do not turn V45's sound/theme lists into shared canon from lab evidence alone.
Do not require hover, tiny precision, hidden scrollbars, UA branches or custom touch inertia.
Do not let drag/scroll also activate the touched item.
Do not refactor Calendar, P4 Capture or Navigator merely to make tactile primitives look uniform.
unresolved: Authentic original controls V9 bytes remain CHAT_ONLY_UNKNOWN as an exact historical artifact.
No Human Accepted exact controls.physical_material artifact is registered.
A canonical/accepted shared sound owner for the V45 profile names was not established by the inspected R05 authority sources.
touch-first v2 and shared material candidates still require their declared representative consumer evidence and/or explicit Human acceptance before promotion.
human_boundary: Only authentic historical recovery or explicit Human acceptance/promotion decisions can close the remaining authority gaps; R05 has no truthful repository-only substitute for those events.
evidence: interaction.touch-first/SPEC.md: CANONICAL SHARED RULE; Current implementation v1.
touch-first/v2/MANIFEST.json: CANDIDATE_NOT_HUMAN_ACCEPTED with representative-consumer-browser-tests + Human acceptance promotion gate.
material.bicolor/v1/MANIFEST.json: candidate-integrated; exactly two theme colors; relief only manipulable; no color-mix helper tones.
Design Kernel v2 and Physical Material v2 are explicitly candidate documents.
Reconstructed V9 visibly uses a free accent wheel and more than two visual roles, proving literal transplantation would conflict with strict bicolor ownership.
Selector V45 source contains sound profile names Oiled, Machine, Snap, Brown, Relay and Soft but no R05 authority record promoting that list.
next_best_action: Consume R05 as a routing/evidence packet. For any concrete tactile defect, change only the smallest existing owner: interaction.touch-first for pointer/gesture mechanics, material.bicolor or another declared material owner for physical skin, and the product owner for product-specific appearance. Require the existing promotion gates before changing Current/Human Accepted/Served state.
